summary: Complete-definition REVISE for one tasks-owned ordering inconsistency. T012 and T013 otherwise preserve the accepted Web callable: T012 exercises actual scoped Program registration with controlled issuer/factory/runtime and a source context issued from its source grant; T013 implements the same service and registration. Opened-context Limited calls are distinct from non-Opened file-only composition; three independent 18.1 functions, exact grants, context-then-lease disposal, cancellation and closed real launch remain. Story 18.3 positive binding/direct-child work is separate. Prior PATH, launch-order, partial-open, runtime-settings, CodeGraph disposition and positive-ownership findings remain resolved. Read-only SpecKit analysis found no other material inconsistency. Deterministic plan/task design validation covered all 32 IDs but cannot detect contradictory completed-task prose. Real JDT, durable store, prepared Repository and canonical O-NFR01 sync remain dependencies. This review grants no approval or qualification.
